title: How sure are we? Covariance, gating and the Kalman filter
summary: Random variables and covariance matrices, error ellipses by eigen-decomposition, J P Jᵀ propagation, Mahalanobis distance and the chi-square gate, inverse-variance fusion, and a Kalman filter you build, test for consistency (NEES) and prove identical to NAVERA's own height filter.
